experiments.question: Does the bounded relationship-graph read beat shared retrieval on multi-hop questions?

evidence.cost: harness wall-clock 81.9s vs 86.4s; provider tokens/cost zero offline

experiments.finding: The bounded graph leg (entity-anchor offline proxy for the Graphiti read at weight 0.1) improves recall@10 by +2.58 points and nDCG@10 by +2.03 points over shared retrieval alone. The LIVE compiled-graph A/B (graph_neo4j node on/off, measured p95 and token spend) remains pending per the runbook.

experiments.question: Does the document-context preamble (deterministic) improve retrieval enough to justify the LLM contextual variant?
experiments.finding: The deterministic recorded overlay lifts overall recall@10 by +12.26 points, concentrated in contracts (+14.29) and statutes; judgments are unchanged and the single filing row regresses on nDCG. This E3 comparison stands as recorded; no extension was needed — the per-class deltas already separate the deterministic preamble's wins from its regressions, and the LLM-generated preamble comparison remains gated on the live quota.

experiments.question: Should BM25 results be force-merged into the fused ranking, and does a bm25_force_merge flag help?
experiments.status: measured offline via harness branch sweeps; production flag does NOT exist
experiments.flag_status: no `bm25_force_merge` setting exists anywhere in src/ (grep over src/, evals/, scripts/); the experiment what-was-run instead isolates each branch leg through the harness --branches sweep, which is the measurement the flag would need
experiments.finding: BM25 force-merge is NOT a free win offline: bm25-alone reaches marginally higher recall@10 (+0.32 points over the default fusion) but loses MRR (-0.61 points) and nDCG (-0.24 points); the trigram leg adds ranking precision, and the graph leg at weight 0.1 dominates every configuration. If a bm25_force_merge flag lands in candidate generation, the offline harness sweep above is the recorded A/B protocol to re-run; until then the flag is recorded as NEEDED-FLAG with this baseline.
